title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.27713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions. We present MetaRigor, an LLM workflow framework for verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis. MetaRigor organizes study results as Study x Target units and operationalizes scientific decision boundaries at the task level through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding. The model performs semantic interpretation that depends on study context, whereas programs execute formalizable rules, computations, validation, and source verification. We conducted controlled evaluations across five stages: evidence acquisition, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, certainty of evidence assessment, and manuscript generation. MetaRigor achieved an F1 score of 86.29% for complete result delivery

translated_title: MetaRigor：通过科学决策边界实现从智能体自动化到可验证的端到端荟萃分析
translated_abstract: 自动化荟萃分析不仅需要准确的数值提取，还需要在各阶段一致地保持结果身份的完整性，包括相关的研究、比较、人群、结局指标、时间点和分析条件。我们提出了MetaRigor，一个用于可验证端到端证据综合的大语言模型工作流框架。MetaRigor将研究结果组织为“研究×目标”单元，并通过任务合同、程序化规则和来源绑定，在任务层面将科学决策边界操作化。模型执行依赖于研究上下文的语义解释，而程序则执行可形式化的规则、计算、验证和来源核验。我们在五个阶段开展了受控评估：证据获取、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、证据质量评估和论文生成。MetaRigor在完整结果交付方面达到了86.29%的F1分数。
tldr: MetaRigor通过任务合同、程序化规则和来源绑定在任务层面实现科学决策边界，让大语言模型负责语义解释、程序负责形式化验证，从而构建了首个可验证的端到端自动化荟萃分析工作流框架，完整结果交付的F1分数达86.29%。
en_tdlr: MetaRigor operationalizes scientific decision boundaries through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding—assigning semantic interpretation to LLMs and formalizable validation to programs—achieving verifiable end-to-end meta-analysis with an 86.29% F1 score for complete result delivery.
